entities.summary: Madilyn Bailey Wold, commonly known as Madilyn Bailey and Madilyn, is an American singer, songwriter, musician, and YouTube personality. She has appeared on multiple TV live shows in France to promote her cover singles and she also promoted her original single "Tetris" on the American TV show Today in 2018. As of October 2025, she has about 9.54 million subscribers on YouTube.
